title: A population-uniform launch avoids the failed clean-zero event
statement: For x=(0,b,c,0,e,f),all four inventories nonnegative and unbounded,N their sum,there are fixed eps,D,N0 depending only on raw rates such that |b-c|,|e-f|<=eps N and N>=N0 earn E[sigma+D Z_out^2]<=D Z_in^2,mean time<=C(N+15) and bounded final Delta Z. Stop at the FIRST unexpected source or joint activation:before it the exact actual process is the seven-state star00,10,20,30,01,02,03,with unbounded residuals fixed parameters. Exact channel occupation/crossing identities give P_harmful<=C_b P_clean_activation,neutral/unclean probabilities similarly bounded,and P_repayment+P_clean_activation>=p_*>0,uniform over every cold/hot ratio. Actual quartic core drift from clean phases(1,1),(2,1),(1,2) reaches an acquired deep band in mean O(N^-3);all noncore hazards are O(N^2),so O(N^-1) interruptions are kept and have nonpositive Delta Z. A FIXED rate-dependent number L of earned normal-cell drainage episodes pays launch debt;choose L before enlarging the population threshold. Bounded final increments plus O(N) physical time give the quadratic contract,without a population loan or stationary/infinite-rate shortcut. Genuine phase1 inputs with nonnegative residuals also satisfy the crossing identity;arbitrary initial phase2/3 does not. The earlier bounded-cold forced-zero route is retained as superseded on this section. High-anchor outputs are received at U but do not thereby acquire their own return operation.

requires: Two ordered degree-seven blocks 0→AB→2A+B+C→3A+2B+2C→0 and 0→DE→2D+E+F→3D+2E+2F→0,all block rates fixed positive;conservative A+D+2B+2C↔A+D+2E+2F at rates2,1. Ordinary falling-factorial propensities without factorial divisors.

Each operation uses its proved input region and actual stopping/output class at U=D Z^2,Z=15+|x|-m(A)-m(D),m=(0,2,4,7,7,...). Small relative pair-difference cone is essential for the unbounded launch/terminal ports.
provides: Exact statement above, at the stated contract.
costs: Charge actual physical holding times,all interruptions/endpoints,normal-cell/finite-kernel acquisition and receiver increments. O(N) mean physical episode time differs from jump activity. General policy/reference/barrier/coverage acquisition and numerical threshold constants are not supplied free.
contract.units: Elapsed physical time,actual endpoint reward,genuine jumps,stationary activity,return moments and exponential return are separate quantities. No physical chemistry operation inferred.
contract.obstruction: Same-principal source proofs,not an independent audit. High anchors,signed packet residuals,large pair differences and arbitrary-list policy acquisition remain open. No full six-species or unrestricted recurrence,exponential return,practical advantage or novelty claim. Chemistry non-operational.
